status: Exploratory extension on the already examined historical period
primary_comparison: coverage on selected top quintile minus coverage on entire eligible universe under the same universally calibrated interval
calibration_weighting: equal weight per historical month, equal weight per available bond within each month
risk_matching: same trailing 24-month 6% risk budget applied to each filtered return stream, capped at 100% risky capital; realized risk can differ
uas_sort: upper bound for long positions, mean plus asset-level absolute-error quantile, as in section 3.4.2
uas_deviations: Published six-model bond ensemble, 36 past months of archived out-of-time errors, long-only decile, common ex ante risk budget; not a replication of 25-year equity cross-validation
coverage_status: empirical predictive intervals for realized returns, no exchangeability or conditional coverage guarantee
